Figure Sampler
Count: 32 Wall: 2 Level: Improver

SECTION 1: VINE AND TOUCHES
1-4 Grapevine right with touch
5 6 Touch left to left side, touch left beside right
7 8 Heel right forward, hook right over left

SECTION 2: PIVOTS AND KICKS
1 2 Step forward left, pivot 1/2 turn right
3 4 Kick left forward, step left beside right
5 6 Cross right over left, step left to left side
7 8 Rock back on right, recover on left

SECTION 3: STOMPS AND CLAPS
1 2 Stomp right forward, hold and clap
3 4 Step back left, touch right beside left
5 6 7 8 Walk right, left, right, hold

SECTION 4: CLOSE OUT
1 2 Step forward right, step left beside right
3 4 Step right to right side, step left beside right
5 6 Step forward right, step forward left
7 8 Rock forward right, recover on left
